name: Festung Kufstein
kurzbeschreibung: Festung Kufstein crowns a 90-metre rock above the River Inn featuring the Kaiserturm, Heroes’ Organ, rock tunnels, and the Kaiser Maximilian panorama funicular.
preis: Adults €15.00 (winter €13.50), children (6–15) €8.50 (winter €7.50), family €33.00; discount with KufsteinerlandCard
oeffnungszeiten: Open year-round: summer daily 09:00–18:00, winter daily 10:00–17:00
beschreibung:
Overview

The formidable Festung Kufstein crowns a sheer 90-metre cliff above the River Inn and stands as the commanding landmark of the Lower Inn Valley border town. First documented in 1205, the fortress was fiercely contested between Bavaria and the Habsburgs over many centuries. Following the legendary siege of 1504, Emperor Maximilian I extensively expanded the fortifications into one of Europe's most formidable strongholds. Its crowning architectural jewel is the colossal circular Kaiserturm tower built in the early 16th century. Today the extensive fortress complex fuses living history with cultural grandeur: it houses the famous Heroes' Organ (Heldenorgel) – the world's largest open-air organ with 4,948 pipes –, a local history museum, a 60-metre-deep well, subterranean rock tunnels, and the historic state prison.

Route & Requirements

The modern panorama funicular "Kaiser Maximilian" whisks visitors up from the historic city centre directly into the fortress in a comfortable, barrier-free glass cabin. Alternatively, the historical covered wooden staircase is open for walkers. Once at the top, a network of paved viewing terraces, open bastions, and covered battlements unfolds. While the main courtyards, restaurant, and organ concerts are fully accessible, reaching the top of the Kaiserturm and the deep underground tunnels involves steep historical stone steps. Sturdy footwear and sure-footedness are recommended for exploring the extensive fortifications and casemates. Multilingual interactive audio guides and guided tours bring centuries of fortress life vividly alive for all ages.

Visit & Arrival

The fortress is open every day throughout the year; from 09:00 to 18:00 in summer and from 10:00 to 17:00 in winter. Drivers reach Kufstein toll-free or via the Inntal motorway A12 (exits Kufstein-Nord or Süd) and can park in the convenient downtown garages. The location is remarkably accessible by train: Kufstein station is an international EuroCity stop for ÖBB and DB trains, located just five minutes' scenic stroll along the Inn river promenade from the funicular base station.

Tips

Arrive in the main fortress courtyard promptly for 12:00 noon: every day, the world-renowned recital of the Heroes' Organ takes place here, sending its powerful music ringing across the entire town and valley. Afterwards, explore the atmospheric underground rock tunnel and dine in the fortress tavern.
